body:
It's the index_class coming out as the bytes b'period' rather than the string 
period' in Python3 that seems to be the issue... this hack seems to fix the problem but I don't know what the right way is:

```
--- pytables.py 2017-05-08 14:40:21.000000000 -0700
+++ pytables.py 2017-06-27 12:37:50.000000000 -0700
@@ -2563,8 +2563,12 @@
         if 'name' in node._v_attrs:
             name = node._v_attrs.name

-        index_class = self._alias_to_class(getattr(node._v_attrs,
-                                                   'index_class', ''))
+        index_class = getattr(node._v_attrs, 'index_class', '')
+
+        if index_class == b'period':
+            index_class = 'period'
+
+        index_class = self._alias_to_class(index_class)
         factory = self._get_index_factory(index_class)

         kwargs = {}
```

I can confirm this on master

>  I don't know if we guarantee 2.7 -> 3.6 compatibility for an on-disk HDF file?

That's indeed the good question. Our docs at least don't mention it is not supported. 
@jreback ?

this is for a ``fixed`` store
we have very little testing or support for ``PeriodIndex``. That said would accept a PR to fix this.

The way this is done in the code is probably not ideal. The hard part here is make this backward compat.

I think you can use

``_ensure_decoded(index_class)`` and this will just work.

Confirmed.. this fixes the issue for me:

```
--- pytables.py 2017-05-08 14:40:21.000000000 -0700
+++ pytables.py 2017-06-28 06:15:57.000000000 -0700
@@ -2563,8 +2563,8 @@
         if 'name' in node._v_attrs:
             name = node._v_attrs.name

-        index_class = self._alias_to_class(getattr(node._v_attrs,
-                                                   'index_class', ''))
+        index_class = self._alias_to_class(_ensure_decoded(
+            getattr(node._v_attrs, 'index_class', '')))
         factory = self._get_index_factory(index_class)

         kwargs = {}
```
great if u can put a PR with the above test and fix would be great
ok i'll work on it today.
